turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Mujhe dedh hazaar chahiye, cotton poplin ka.

gloss: Buyer: I need one and a half thousand, of cotton poplin.
note: Quantity 1500 with no unit (meter, roll, kg or piece). Nothing else is stated.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: અમે સવા હજાર મોકલી દઈશું, રેયોન.

gloss: Seller: We will send one and a quarter thousand, rayon.
note: Quantity 1250 with no unit. The Gujarati number word sava hajar must be read as 1250.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Mujhe 500 roll chahiye, rayon ka.

gloss: Buyer: I need 500 rolls, of rayon.
note: Roll is a unit whose length is not stated, so the total meters are unknown.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: દસ થાન તૈયાર છે, પોલિએસ્ટરના.

gloss: Seller: Ten than are ready, of polyester.
note: Than is a cut length of fabric with no fixed size, so the meters per than are unknown.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: પાંચસો માલ આવતા શુક્રવારે મળી જશે.

gloss: Seller: Five hundred of the goods will reach you next Friday.
note: Next Friday is relative and depends on the speaking day (A3). Five hundred has no unit (A1).

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Delivery Diwali ke baad kar dena.

gloss: Buyer: Please deliver after Diwali.
note: After Diwali is a relative, open-ended date. No quantity or price is stated.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: ભાવ મીટરના 118 રૂપિયા.

gloss: Seller: The rate is 118 rupees per meter.
note: Price and basis are clear, but it is not said whether GST is included or extra.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Rate dedh sau rupaye per meter rakhiye.

gloss: Buyer: Please keep the rate at one and a half hundred rupees per meter.
note: Dedh sau is 150. Basis is per meter, but GST treatment is not stated.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: ભાવ 118 રૂપિયા, GST સાથે.

gloss: Seller: The rate is 118 rupees, including GST.
note: GST is stated, but the basis (per meter, per kg, per piece) is missing.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Rate 95 rupaye hai, GST alag se.

gloss: Buyer: The rate is 95 rupees, GST separately.
note: GST is extra and clear. The basis of the 95 rupees is missing.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: ત્રીસ ટકા એડવાન્સ આપવો પડશે.

gloss: Seller: You will have to give thirty percent advance.
note: Advance is stated, but when the balance is due is not.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Pachaas percent advance dunga, baaki baad mein dekhenge.

gloss: Buyer: I will give fifty percent advance, we will see about the rest later.
note: The balance trigger is left open (later), so the payment terms are incomplete.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Cotton ka kapda chahiye, 44 ya 58 inch wala, jo bhi mil jaye.

gloss: Buyer: I need cotton cloth, 44 or 58 inch wide, whichever is available.
note: Width is left open between two values. No quantity, price or date is stated.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: સાટિન આપીશું, રંગ તમારી પસંદગીનો, વજન સારું રાખીશું.

gloss: Seller: We will give satin, a colour of your choice, we will keep the weight good.
note: Shade is not chosen and weight (GSM) is a vague promise, so the spec is unclear.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: ભાવ મીટરના 118 રૂપિયા, GST અલગ.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Theek hai, 118 per meter plus GST.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: ભાવ મીટરના 120 રૂપિયા, GST અલગ.

gloss: Seller: 118 rupees per meter, GST extra. Buyer: Fine, 118 per meter plus GST. Seller: 120 rupees per meter, GST extra.
note: The first price is complete and accepted. The seller then states 120 without saying it is a change.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: સાડા ત્રણસો રૂપિયા મીટરના, GST અલગ.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Theek hai, saade teen sau per meter plus GST.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: ઠીક છે, ત્રણસો પંચાવન રૂપિયા મીટરના, GST અલગ.

gloss: Seller: Three hundred fifty rupees per meter, GST extra. Buyer: Fine, three fifty per meter plus GST. Seller: Okay, three hundred fifty-five rupees per meter, GST extra.
note: Price moves from 350 to 355 with an ordinary 'okay' that does not acknowledge the change.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: બે રીતે થઈ શકે: 12 નવેમ્બરે અડધો માલ, અથવા 16 નવેમ્બરે આખો માલ.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Haan, theek hai.

gloss: Seller: It can be done two ways: half the goods on 12 November, or all the goods on 16 November. Buyer: Yes, fine.
note: Dates are absolute. The buyer's yes follows two different proposals and does not say which one.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: મીટરના 110 રૂપિયા GST સાથે, અથવા સારી ક્વોલિટીના 125 રૂપિયા GST સાથે.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Haan, okay.

gloss: Seller: 110 rupees per meter including GST, or 125 rupees including GST for better quality. Buyer: Yes, okay.
note: Both prices are complete (per meter, GST included). The assent does not choose between them.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Rate 5 dollar hai, GST extra.

gloss: Buyer: The rate is 5 dollars, GST extra.
note: Dollar against rupee is a currency flag (A10). The basis of the 5 dollars is also missing (A5).

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: ભાવ 2 ડોલર મીટરના, GST અલગ, રૂપિયામાં પણ ચાલશે.

gloss: Seller: The rate is 2 dollars per meter, GST extra, rupees will also work.
note: Basis and GST are clear. It is unclear whether the price is in dollars or rupees, and at what conversion.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: અમે 500 મીટર કોટન પોપ્લિન આપીશું, 44 ઇંચ પહોળું, સફેદ રંગ. ભાવ 118 રૂપિયા મીટરના, GST 5 ટકા અલગ. ડિલિવરી 20 નવેમ્બર 2026ના રોજ. 30 ટકા એડવાન્સ, બાકીના પૈસા ડિલિવરી વખતે.

gloss: Seller: We will supply 500 meters of cotton poplin, 44 inch wide, white. Rate 118 rupees per meter, 5 percent GST extra. Delivery on 20 November 2026. 30 percent advance, the rest on delivery.
note: Clean. Unit, spec, price with currency, basis and GST, absolute date, advance and balance trigger are all stated.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: એક હજાર મીટર રેયોન, 58 ઇંચ, મરૂન રંગ, 125 રૂપિયા મીટરના, GST 5 ટકા સાથે. કુલ સવા લાખ રૂપિયા.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Theek hai. Delivery 25 November 2026 ko, 50 percent advance, baaki delivery ke time.

gloss: Seller: One thousand meters of rayon, 58 inch, maroon, 125 rupees per meter, 5 percent GST included. Total one and a quarter lakh rupees. Buyer: Fine. Delivery on 25 November 2026, 50 percent advance, the rest at delivery.
note: Clean. 1000 x 125 = 125000, so sava lakh matches the stated rate and is a consistent total.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Mujhe 2000 meter polyester chahiye, 60 inch width, black. Rate 62 rupaye per meter, GST 5 percent extra. Delivery 30 November 2026. 40 percent advance, baaki 30 din baad delivery ke.

gloss: Buyer: I need 2000 meters of polyester, 60 inch width, black. Rate 62 rupees per meter, 5 percent GST extra. Delivery 30 November 2026. 40 percent advance, the rest 30 days after delivery.
note: Clean. All slots are explicit, balance trigger is 30 days after delivery.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: मुझे 800 मीटर सैटिन चाहिए, 44 इंच चौड़ाई, नेवी ब्लू। रेट 210 रुपये प्रति मीटर, जीएसटी 5 प्रतिशत अलग। डिलीवरी 15 नवंबर 2026 को। 25 प्रतिशत एडवांस, बाकी डिलीवरी पर।

gloss: Buyer: I need 800 meters of satin, 44 inch width, navy blue. Rate 210 rupees per meter, 5 percent GST extra. Delivery on 15 November 2026. 25 percent advance, the rest on delivery.
note: Clean. Devanagari script version with all slots stated.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: 300 મીટર સિલ્ક, 44 ઇંચ, ગુલાબી રંગ. સાડા ત્રણસો રૂપિયા મીટરના, GST 5 ટકા અલગ.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Theek hai. Delivery 18 November 2026, 30 percent advance, baaki delivery par.

gloss: Seller: 300 meters of silk, 44 inch, pink. Three hundred fifty rupees per meter, 5 percent GST extra. Buyer: Fine. Delivery 18 November 2026, 30 percent advance, the rest on delivery.
note: Clean. Saade teen sau is 350 and appears once, with no later change.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: દોઢ હજાર મીટર ડેનિમ, 58 ઇંચ, 10 ઔંસ, ઇન્ડિગો રંગ. ભાવ 140 રૂપિયા મીટરના, GST સાથે. ડિલિવરી 28 નવેમ્બર 2026. એડવાન્સ 20 ટકા, બાકી ડિલિવરી પછી 15 દિવસમાં.

gloss: Seller: One and a half thousand meters of denim, 58 inch, 10 ounce, indigo. Rate 140 rupees per meter, GST included. Delivery 28 November 2026. Advance 20 percent, the rest within 15 days after delivery.
note: Clean. Weight is given as 10 ounce, so the spec is explicit.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Mujhe 600 meter georgette chahiye, 44 inch, peach colour, 95 rupaye per meter plus 5 percent GST.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: ઠીક છે. ડિલિવરી 22 નવેમ્બર 2026, 50 ટકા એડવાન્સ, બાકી ડિલિવરી વખતે.

gloss: Buyer: I need 600 meters of georgette, 44 inch, peach colour, 95 rupees per meter plus 5 percent GST. Seller: Fine. Delivery 22 November 2026, 50 percent advance, the rest at delivery.
note: Clean. Price comes from the buyer, delivery and payment from the seller, nothing is left open.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: અઢીસો મીટર શિફોન, 44 ઇંચ, આછો લીલો રંગ, 88 રૂપિયા મીટરના, GST 5 ટકા અલગ. ડિલિવરી 12 નવેમ્બર 2026, 30 ટકા એડવાન્સ, બાકી ડિલિવરી વખતે.

gloss: Seller: Two and a half hundred meters of chiffon, 44 inch, light green, 88 rupees per meter, 5 percent GST extra. Delivery 12 November 2026, 30 percent advance, the rest at delivery.
note: Clean. Adhaai sau (250) is a number word with a clear unit and all other slots.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Mujhe 3000 meter cotton lawn chahiye, 44 inch, white. Rate 54 rupaye per meter, GST 5 percent included. Delivery 3 December 2026. 20 percent advance, balance 30 din baad delivery ke.

gloss: Buyer: I need 3000 meters of cotton lawn, 44 inch, white. Rate 54 rupees per meter, 5 percent GST included. Delivery 3 December 2026. 20 percent advance, balance 30 days after delivery.
note: Clean. All slots are explicit.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: 1200 મીટર વેલ્વેટ, 44 ઇંચ, વાઇન રંગ, 260 રૂપિયા મીટરના, GST 5 ટકા અલગ.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: ठीक है। डिलीवरी 27 नवंबर 2026, 35 प्रतिशत एडवांस, बाकी डिलीवरी पर।

gloss: Seller: 1200 meters of velvet, 44 inch, wine colour, 260 rupees per meter, 5 percent GST extra. Buyer: Fine. Delivery 27 November 2026, 35 percent advance, the rest on delivery.
note: Clean. Mixes Gujarati and Devanagari turns, all slots stated.
